fixes.explanation: Jacob, baker! The Lord GOD, the God of Hosts, says, “Hear and testify against the house of Jacob…” (Amos 3:13). That name is the one that fills the blank. The One speaking is the Lord GOD Himself, and the house He names is Jacob's. Well done.
